# `Q-24-1` — Unsupported Import File Type

> The file's type is not one the importer reads. Document import supports Word (.docx), OpenDocument text (.odt), Rich Text Format (.rtf), EPUB (.epub) and PowerPoint (.pptx) files.

## What this means

The file's extension is not one of the formats the importer reads, so nothing was converted.

## Why this happens

- The file is a different kind of document, such as `.doc` (the old binary Word format), `.pdf`, `.md` or `.html`.
- The file was renamed, and its extension no longer matches its contents.

## How to fix

Save the document as one of the supported types (in Word: File → Save As → Word Document (.docx)) and import that. Files you want to keep as they are, without conversion, can be added with the *Add asset* dialog instead.
